
<title>SIBE Entry Checklist</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Chakra+Petch:wght@500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#0A0A12;--panel:#10101B;--line:#28243f;--purple:#6E4FFF;--blue:#4F7FFF;--text:#f4f3fa;--muted:#9493a5}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0,#21185a55,transparent 38%),#0A0A12;color:var(--text);font-family:Inter,sans-serif;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:24px 15px}
.shell{width:min(760px,100%)}.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;margin:0 0 16px 3px}.brand img{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:1px solid #6e4fff88;box-shadow:0 0 18px #6e4fff33}.brand span{font:600 13px "Chakra Petch";letter-spacing:.2em;color:#aaa8bb}
.card{padding:30px;border-radius:22px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#141421f5,#0d0d15f8);border:1px solid #6e4fff2b;box-shadow:0 25px 70px #0008,inset 0 1px #fff06}
h1{margin:0;font:700 clamp(28px,5vw,42px)/1.05 "Chakra Petch";letter-spacing:-.02em;background:linear-gradient(105deg,#fff,#c7c4d4,#fff,#7e8098);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.sub{margin:10px 0 24px;color:#b6b4c5;font-size:14px}
.list{display:grid;gap:9px}.item{position:relative;display:flex;gap:13px;align-items:flex-start;padding:14px 15px;border:1px solid #a5a1bd1c;border-radius:13px;background:#ffffff04;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s ease}.item:hover{border-color:#6e4fff66}.item.checked{border-color:#6e4fffaa;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6e4fff18,#4f7fff0b);box-shadow:0 0 22px #6e4fff1f}
input{position:absolute;opacity:0}.box{width:23px;height:23px;flex:0 0 23px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid #4b4c5e;background:#0b0b13;display:grid;place-items:center;margin-top:1px}.box:after{content:"✓";opacity:0;color:#fff;font-weight:800}.checked .box{border:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--purple),var(--blue));box-shadow:0 0 14px #6e4fff77}.checked .box:after{opacity:1}
.label{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.48;color:#deddea}.num{font:700 11px "JetBrains Mono";color:#77798a;margin-right:7px}
.result{margin-top:22px;padding-top:21px;border-top:1px solid #aaa5bd18;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}.caption{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.15em;font-size:10px;color:#858697}.note{margin-top:8px;font-size:11.5px;color:#9493a5;max-width:220px}.score{margin-top:6px;font:700 25px "JetBrains Mono"}.grade{font:700 clamp(55px,10vw,80px)/1 "Chakra Petch";min-width:150px;text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#898692,#50515f);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}.grade.a{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c3b5ff,#6e4fff,#4f7fff);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 18px #6e4fff88)}.grade.aplus{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#a99bff,#4f9cff);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 28px #4f7fffcc)}
.footer{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:16px}button{border:1px solid #6e4fff55;background:#ffffff07;color:#ddd9eb;border-radius:9px;padding:9px 15px;font:600 11px "Chakra Petch";letter-spacing:.1em;cursor:pointer}button:hover{border-color:#6e4fffbb;background:#6e4fff16}
@media(max-width:560px){.card{padding:21px}.result{flex-direction:column;text-align:center;gap:12px}.footer{justify-content:center}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*:before,*:after{transition:none!important}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<main class="shell">
<div class="brand"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64, alt="KashFlow logo"><span>KASHFLOW TRADING</span></div>
<section class="card">
<h1>SIBE Entry Checklist</h1>
<p class="sub">Sweep → Inverse → BOS → Entry. One point per box, plus bonus confluence.</p>
<div class="list" id="list">
<label class="item"><input type="checkbox"><span class="box"></span><span class="label"><span class="num">S</span>Marked out the 1H swing high/low (or 15min session high/low if the 1H level is too far away)</span></label>
<label class="item"><input type="checkbox"><span class="box"></span><span class="label"><span class="num">S</span>Swept that level cleanly</span></label>
<label class="item"><input type="checkbox"><span class="box"></span><span class="label"><span class="num">I</span>Clear inverse of the 5min FVG</span></label>
<label class="item"><input type="checkbox"><span class="box"></span><span class="label"><span class="num">B</span>First BOS present</span></label>
<label class="item"><input type="checkbox"><span class="box"></span><span class="label"><span class="num">E</span>Second BOS</span></label>
<label class="item"><input type="checkbox"><span class="box"></span><span class="label"><span class="num">+</span>Bonus: 1min iFVG present in the trade direction</span></label>
<label class="item"><input type="checkbox"><span class="box"></span><span class="label"><span class="num">+</span>Bonus: Candle closes on the correct side of the 13 EMA</span></label>
</div>
<div class="result"><div><div class="caption">Entry Score</div><div class="score"><span id="points">0</span> / 7</div><div class="note" id="note">Not a valid setup</div></div><div class="grade" id="grade">—</div></div>
<div class="footer"><button id="reset">RESET</button></div>
</section>
</main>
<script>
const items=[...document.querySelectorAll('.item')],points=document.getElementById('points'),grade=document.getElementById('grade'),note=document.getElementById('note');
const grades=['—','C','B-','B','B+','A','A+','A+'];
const notes=['Not a valid setup','Skip it','Skip it','Size down if you take it','Size down if you take it','Tradeable','Full size, this is the one','Full size, this is the one'];
function update(){let n=items.filter(x=>x.querySelector('input').checked).length;points.textContent=n;grade.textContent=grades[n];note.textContent=notes[n];grade.classList.toggle('a',n>=5);grade.classList.toggle('aplus',n>=6);items.forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('checked',x.querySelector('input').checked))}
items.forEach(x=>{let c=x.querySelector('input');c.addEventListener('change',update);});
document.getElementById('reset').onclick=()=>{items.forEach(x=>x.querySelector('input').checked=false);update()};update();
</script>
</body>
</html>
